text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Those eyes say it all! As does your 
majestic bearing! Lord Furioso, you truly 
possess the caliber to rule the realm!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It is not merely about conquering the 
peak. The power to care for others, 
shoulder their burdens, and govern. It is 
to someone like you—sincere even to 
passersby—that—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...No. I won't be swayed by your sweet 
talk ever again."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Next, you'll probably ask to borrow my 
math notes or something. Treating me like 
some close friend just to...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha! That is true! You carry the whole 
domain of Funabashi upon your shoulders. 
One cannot act casually, my apologies, my 
apologies!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"...Drat, this is a pickle. If it's not 
Lord Furioso, then... hmm."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmmmm, what a pickle this is~~... *glance* 
Who should I talk to first... Mmm... 
*glance*

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Is it such a serious worry that you are 
having this much trouble deciding who to 
consult?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nowawaa!? Therefore, therefore! I cannot 
trouble Furioso-dono! I must somehow, 
somehow manage this on my own...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...If it's just listening, sure. But I 
won't be taking any requests.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Bless ya! Well then, just hear me out! 
It's about this new headband I saw at the 
shop the other day~âª
